display.title: Learning the Weekly Parsha Every Day
display.summary_short: In the week of Tetzaveh, Uncle Yossi explains why we learn a portion of the weekly sedra with Rashi each day, so the Torah fills every day of our lives.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given in the week of Parshas Tetzaveh. Uncle Yossi explains that each Shabbos we read a new sedra, but we do not wait for Shabbos to learn it: starting on Sunday we study it every day, together with Rashi's explanations, so we are ready by Shabbos. He introduces Rashi, Rabbi Shlomo ben Yitzchak, and explains that the sedra is divided into seven parts, one for each day: Sunday from the beginning until Sheni, Monday from Sheni until Shlishi, and so on until Shabbos completes it. We learn Torah every single day to show Hashem how much we love His Torah, and because the Torah is our very life, as we say each evening in davening: 'ki hem chayeinu', the words of Torah are our life and the length of our days.
display.lesson: Learn a part of the weekly parsha with Rashi every day; a day should never pass without Torah.
